entries.title: Version 1 launched with 27 apps
entries.detail: First full check of banks, brokerages, budgeting apps and data aggregators. Every row shows its sources and the date it was checked.

entries.title: Monarch: connector docs still exclude Finicity-linked accounts
entries.detail: Monarch's MCP help page was recently updated and still lists Finicity-sourced accounts as excluded.

entries.title: Schwab: CEO describes pilot MCP access starting with Claude
entries.detail: On its Q3 call Schwab said clients can connect their own model through a supervised pilot, starting with Claude, and that connected models cannot move money. Permissions were not published.

entries.title: Chase: blocks agents that log in with your password, still supports Plaid
entries.detail: JPMorgan said it blocks outside AI agents that sign in using customer credentials. Customer-approved sharing through providers like Plaid remains supported. Reported via CNBC, relayed by a secondary source.

entries.title: Citi and Bank of America reported to be limiting AI agents
entries.detail: The Financial Times reported both banks are restricting agent access to accounts. We have not found statements from either bank.

entries.title: Grok: Finance integration announced
entries.detail: xAI's official @bot account announced a Finance integration that links bank, card and investment accounts through Plaid, read-only. No institution list was published.

entries.title: Claude: 'Money' section spotted in testing
entries.detail: BleepingComputer reported Anthropic testing a bank-linking feature in the Claude iOS app. Not launched, no bank list, no date.
